articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
articles.snippet: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

articles.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
articles.snippet: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.

articles.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
articles.snippet: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.

articles.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

articles.title: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears
articles.snippet: Savers locked out of Ueno Bank burned their cards, booed a former presidential candidate out of the crowd, and watched Congress move to remove President Peña.
